resources.string: Off by default. When you turn on an add-on subtitle, its timing is lined up with the subtitles built into the video, or on Android with the dialogue in the audio when there are none. Only confident matches are applied, and subtitles are never turned on for you.
Keeps comparing other subtitles and embedded tracks for a closer match before syncing. Only confident matches are ever applied.
Uses the first strong match sooner. Only confident matches are ever applied, as with Thorough.
Keep the original subtitle timing when the sync would move it by no more than this. Tap to change.
